title:
STATISTICS,
(CUMULATIVE FREQUENCY AND BOX PLOTS)
objective: LO: I can draw and interpret cumulative frequency diagrams and box plots.

content.text: Cumulative frequency is the running total of frequencies. A box plot (box-and-whisker diagram) displays the minimum, lower quartile (Q1), median (Q2), upper quartile (Q3), and maximum.
Strategy: Add frequencies cumulatively, plot against upper class boundaries, then read off Q1 (at &frac{n}{4}), Q2 (at &frac{n}{2}), Q3 (at &frac{3n}{4}).

examples.expr: IQR = Q3 − Q1 measures the spread of middle 50%
Median is at the &frac{n}{2} position on the CF curve
Box plot shows min, Q1, Q2, Q3, max

key_idea.title: Key idea
key_idea.text: Cumulative frequency = running total. Read quartiles from the CF graph. IQR = Q3 − Q1.
key_idea.caption: The interquartile range measures spread of the middle 50% of data

modelled_examples.label: Example 1 – building a CF table
modelled_examples.question: Frequencies are 5, 8, 12, 10, 5. Build the cumulative frequency column.
modelled_examples.explanation: Add each frequency to the running total.

modelled_examples.label: Example 2 – reading the median
modelled_examples.question: n = 40. Read the median from the CF graph.
steps: Go across from CF = 20 to the curve
Read down to the x-axis for the median
modelled_examples.explanation: The median is the value at the &frac{n}{2} position on the y-axis.

modelled_examples.label: Example 3 – finding IQR
modelled_examples.question: From a CF graph: Q1 = 35, Q3 = 58. Find the IQR.
modelled_examples.explanation: The IQR tells us the range of the middle 50% of the data.

modelled_examples.label: Example 4 – drawing a box plot
modelled_examples.question: Min = 12, Q1 = 25, Q2 = 33, Q3 = 45, Max = 60. Describe the box plot.
steps: Draw a number line from 10 to 65
Box from Q1 (25) to Q3 (45), line at median (33)
Whiskers from 12 (min) to box and box to 60 (max)
modelled_examples.answer: Box: 25 to 45, median at 33, whiskers 12 and 60
modelled_examples.explanation: Five values define the entire box plot.

items.statement: CF should be plotted against class midpoints
The median is read at the &frac{n}{2} position on the CF graph
The box in a box plot always shows 25% of the data
A box plot shows the five-number summary: min, Q1, Q2, Q3, max

problems.text: A CF diagram shows n = 80 students. From the curve: Q1 = 42 marks, median = 55, Q3 = 67. The pass mark is 50. Estimate the number who passed. Draw a box plot if min = 20 and max = 90.

Two box plots compare test scores. Class A: min 25, Q1 40, Q2 55, Q3 70, max 95. Class B: min 35, Q1 50, Q2 60, Q3 65, max 80. Write three comparisons using correct statistical language (median, IQR, range, skewness).
